data.one_liner: Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier implementation for Dart
data.what_it_does: Generates and parses ULIDs in Dart with binary compatibility and monotonicity support. Encodes 128 bits of randomness and timestamps into Crockford's base32 strings.
use_when: You need lexicographically sortable unique identifiers
You want a character-efficient alternative to UUIDs
You require monotonicity support for identifiers generated in the same millisecond
avoid_when: You specifically require standard UUID format for legacy systems
strengths: Binary implementation support and byte array conversion
weaknesses: Limited to ULID generation and parsing

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need standard RFC-compliant UUIDs instead of ULIDs.
